query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks l
                JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = l.pid
                WHERE l.locktype = 'advisory'
                  AND l.granted
                  AND l.classid = ($1::int)::oid
                  AND l.objid = (hashtext($2))::oid
                  AND l.objsubid = 2
                  AND a.application_name = $3
            ) AS "held!"
